resources.string:
StudyGuard helps you stay focused by detecting and optionally blocking short-form video feeds (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, etc.) and enforcing app restrictions during study sessions.

 What is read:
 • View IDs, text labels, and content descriptions in apps you configure for blocking
 • Current foreground app to trigger focus reminders
 • Settings app content to prevent accidental service disabling during focus

 What is NOT read:
 • Messages, emails, or private conversations
 • Passwords or authentication credentials
 • Content from apps not configured for blocking

 Privacy:
 All inspection happens locally on your device. No screen content, app usage, or personal data is transmitted to any server. The service only acts when a configured rule matches, and only the configured action (pressing BACK or HOME) occurs.

 This service is entirely opt-in and can be disabled at any time in Android accessibility settings.
